subject: B2 authored challenge shoreline, wet ground and campfire

notes: One retained baseline and final short run; draft tuning captures are excluded. GPU browser workloads did not overlap. Environment clocks are not phase-locked.
All four challenge checkpoints and camera settings are byte-identical; live movement is wall-clock input, not a fixed-tick replay.
Only finite challenge scenes replace their hex surface. Wilderness retains existing terrain and is checked for resource headroom with scenery assets resident.
CPU is map main-thread work, excluding authority Worker cost and loading spikes. Resource bytes are ledger estimates, not driver VRAM.
Screenshots render at native 1440p; video is 720p. This is not a complete-game, minimum-hardware or worst-case 60 FPS certification.
Added six 512px textures, fixed geometry and one unshadowed point light; no render targets. Ordinary grass does not receive the point light.

Full app E2E initially passed 48/49. The fog probe selected shaders via a terrain substring also present in grass/water; it now selects resident visible land. Targeted fog and challenge rerun passed. Library 29 E2E include 500 world replacements; world-style gallery 22 passed.
